Bear Market refers to a prolonged period of falling prices in crypto assets. Bear Market conditions are generally associated with declining investor confidence. Bear Market periods are often described as a decline of about 20 percent from recent highs.

Blockchain Trilemma describes the claim that a blockchain cannot simultaneously achieve decentralization, security, and scalability. Blockchain Trilemma implies that improving one of these three properties tends to come at the cost of another. Blockchain Trilemma is often cited as a design constraint in discussions of blockchain protocols.

Bull Market refers to a prolonged period of rising prices in crypto assets. Bull Market conditions are generally associated with growing investor optimism. Bull Market periods are often marked by increased trading activity and new market entrants.

Bull Trap refers to a false signal of a price rise that is followed by a reversal into a downtrend. Bull Trap catches buyers who enter a position expecting further gains. Bull Trap is typically identified only after the price has turned downward.
